tools.name: create_render
tools.description: Create a private preview from one product photo. Supply exactly one upload_id, image_url or image_base64. Upload larger local photos with authenticated POST /api/uploads (multipart image), then pass its id. Inline images: at most 3129344 decoded bytes. URL/upload photos: up to 4 MiB. Reuse idempoten

tools.name: get_render
tools.description: Read render status, artifact links and pending credits. Poll every 5–15 seconds. This may advance an already-authorized job; it does not authorize another paid generation. Private links need the same bearer authentication. Pass export_format (obj, fbx or blend) on a ready render you own to also get

tools.name: render_3d
tools.description: Build an approved preview. Without quality it is the standard build for pending_credits. Pass quality medium or high for a finer model: the price is qualityCredits[quality] minus credits already recorded (get_credits quotes them). Send max_credits as the authorized ceiling. Repeating the same runnin

tools.name: rebuild_standard
tools.description: Rebuild a ready medium or high model in standard quality for free. The credit difference between what the model cost and the standard price is returned once, in the same step, however many times this is called. The old model is replaced when the new one is ready; poll get_render. Fails with bad_stat

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Balance, current operation costs, buyer currency, public offers and actual account top-up rate. Prices are in currency; no purchase is made.

tools.name: list_renders
tools.description: Find and recover your renders, newest first. Follow next_cursor to retrieve more. Only this account’s renders are listed.

tools.name: set_render_visibility
tools.description: Explicitly publish a finished model in the public gallery or make it private. Requires share permission; publishing exposes the render to other people.

tools.name: start_render_sheet
tools.description: Generate a paid angle sheet for a preview without one. Existing sheets/jobs are reused. The sheet cost counts toward the later 3D build. Query get_credits.sheet_credits first.

tools.name: redraw_render_sheet
tools.description: Pay to redraw a preview sheet using a correction note. Each completed redraw is a new charge and does not count toward the 3D cost. On timeout inspect the same render before deciding whether to repeat.

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Enlarge an owned product view or the sheet of a paid render. Quote upscale_credits with get_credits. Existing enlargements may be reused; query get_upscale to track the result, or list_upscales to recover its id. Do not repeat an uncertain request automatically.

tools.name: get_upscale
tools.description: Read your enlargement’s status and authenticated image URL. Poll every 5–15 seconds until ready or failed.

tools.name: create_product_views
tools.description: Buy nine product photos from one source photo. This is a paid operation, separate from the free 3D preview. Query product_views_credits with get_credits and obtain authorization. On timeout recover the existing set using list_product_views before retrying.

tools.name: get_product_views
tools.description: Read your product-view set’s state, quality flags, follow-up costs and authenticated ZIP URL. Poll until ready or failed.

tools.name: list_product_views
tools.description: Recover your latest product-view sets, newest first. Returns at most limit entries (default 24, maximum 100); this is a bounded recent list, without pagination.

tools.name: list_upscales
tools.description: Recover up to 50 of your current enlargements for one render or product-view set, newest first. Supply exactly one render_id or view_set_id. Replaced source images are excluded.

tools.name: polish_product_view
tools.description: Pay to correct one ready product photo using a note. Quote view_polish_credits first. Check get_product_views after a timeout; repeating a completed polish incurs a new charge.

tools.name: build_from_product_views
tools.description: Build a GLB from a completed product-view set, reusing its paid sheet. Quote build_from_views_credits first. Existing running/ready builds are reused. On timeout recover renderId through get_product_views.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upscale, get_product_views · Private data: create_render, get_render, set_render_visibility · Public sink: create_render, render_3d, set_render_visibility.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upscale, get_product_views · Private data: create_render, get_render, set_render_visibility · Public sink: create_render, render_3d, set_render_visibility

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "render_3d" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Build an approved preview for its pending_credits. Send max_credits as the authorized ceiling. Repeating the same running/ready render does not charge again. On timeout query the same id before retrying; never create another paid render automatically." → after: "Build an approved preview. Without quality it is the standard build for pending_credits. Pass quality medium or high for a finer model: the price is qualityCredits[quality] minus credits already recorded (get_credits quotes them). Send max_credits as the authorized ceiling. Repeating the same runnin"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
